# Intergrax — Full LLM Context Map

> Extended project map for LLM agents, crawlers, and automated documentation tools.
> Canonical source of truth: `docs/` — this file summarizes and routes; it does not replace canon.

## Project identity

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Name** | Intergrax |
| **Tagline** | Agent OS and Harness AI runtime |
| **Language** | Python 3.12 |

| **Repository** | https://github.com/jakbuczarnecki/intergrax-ai |
| **Maintainer** | Artur Czarnecki |
| **Status** | Active private R&D; harness platform complete |
| **License** | Proprietary — see LICENSE |

### One-line thesis

> Can we rapidly create, run, and evaluate new AI agents without rebuilding infrastructure every time?

### Strategic goal

Build a **modern, production-grade Harness AI** and **Agent Operating System** aligned with leading agent platforms (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex-class harnesses, Viktor, Google ADK-style labs). Source: docs/INTERGRAX_DEVELOPMENT_STRATEGY.md

---

## What Intergrax is / is not

### Is

- Four-tier AI platform: Platform (Tier-0) → Nexus Agent OS (Tier-1) → Agents (Tier-2) → Applications (Tier-3)
- Harness AI environment with policy, tools, skills, context engineering, trace, composable agents
- Agent experimentation laboratory (idea → first traced run < 1 hour)
- Capability execution platform: Integration → Tool → Skill → Agent
- Integration bridge to organizational systems (Jira, Slack, PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant, …)

### Is not

- A chatbot, prompt collection, single agent, workflow builder, marketplace, or finished multi-tenant SaaS

---

## Four-tier architecture

```text
Tier-3  Applications     →  deployable products (legal API, lab host, research service)
Tier-2  Agents           →  specialized capability modules
Tier-1  Nexus Runtime    →  Agent OS (NexusLoop, AgentEngine, UAEP, governance)
Tier-0  Platform         →  integrations, tools, skills, LLM, RAG, memory, logging
```

### Mandatory dependency rules

```text
intergrax/       MUST NOT import from agents/ or applications/
agents/          MUST NOT import from applications/
applications/    MAY import from agents/ and intergrax/
```

Agents must not import vendor SDKs directly — consume Tier-0 through Nexus policy and ToolRuntime.

### Repository paths

```text
intergrax/              # Tier-0 + Tier-1 Nexus
  integrations/         # 99 integration providers
  tools/                # Tool Library + MCP
  skills/               # Skill Library
  llm_adapters/         # 19 LLM providers
  rag/                  # Retrieval, ingest, embeddings
  memory/               # Session, STM/LTM
  runtime/              # NexusLoop, AgentEngine, UAEP, governance
  applications/         # Tier-3 composition engine
  scaffold/             # new-agent, new-application, new-skill, new-stack
agents/                 # Tier-2 agents
applications/           # Tier-3 deployable environments
docs/                   # Canonical documentation
infra/                  # Local Docker compose
tests/                  # Unit, integration, acceptance
scripts/                # Harness CI checks
```

## Capability stack (Harness AI)

| Layer | LLM-invokable | Example |
|-------|---------------|---------|
| Integration | No | PostgreSQL, Bing, Jira REST |
| Tool | Yes | rag.retrieve, jira.search_tasks |
| Skill | No (runtime resolves) | legal.contract_review |
| Agent | — | LegalAgent in agents/legal/ |

Catalogs: docs/INTEGRATIONS.md (99 providers) · docs/TOOLS.md · docs/SKILLS.md

---

## Nexus runtime (Tier-1)

Core components:

- **NexusLoop** — task intake, planning, lifecycle
- **AgentRegistry** — registration, capability routing
- **AgentEngine** — Nexus → agent UAEP bridge
- **ExecutionGraph** — multi-agent workflows
- **ToolRuntime** — unified tool gateway (policy, trace, idempotency)
- **PolicyEngine** — pre-run, pre-tool, post-tool governance
- **ContextManager** — context assembly, budget trimming

Orchestration: `intergrax/runtime/nexus/orchestration/` (intake_runner, planning_runner, graph_runner, hitl_runner, …)

UAEP (Unified Agent Execution Protocol): docs/intergrax_runtime_architecture.md §42

---

## Laboratory vs production harness

| Mode | Purpose | Metric |
|------|---------|--------|
| Laboratory | Fast hypothesis validation | Idea → traced run < 1 hour |
| Production harness | Reliable Agent OS at scale | Reference agents + stable paths + ops SLOs |

Same codebase, different operational posture. Lab stack: docs/HARNESS_ENVIRONMENT.md

## Quick start

```bash
# Prerequisites: Python 3.12, uv

# Verify platform health
uv run pytest tests/acceptance/agent_os -m agent_os -q
uv run pytest -m gate -q
python scripts/check_harness_no_getattr.py

# Scaffold first agent
python -m intergrax.scaffold new-agent my_agent --capability domain.action

# CLI shortcuts
uv run intergrax run <module>:app
uv run intergrax doctor
uv run python -m intergrax.scaffold new-stack <name>
```

Full workflow: docs/AGENT_CREATION_GUIDE.md

## AI agent instructions

1. Read AGENTS.md before modifying code
2. Follow docs/INTERGRAX_DEVELOPMENT_STRATEGY.md work cycle: analyze → assess architecture → update docs → implement → verify
3. Never modify `intergrax/runtime/` when creating Tier-2 agents
4. Link to docs/ — do not duplicate canon in new files
5. Run gate tests after harness changes: `uv run pytest -m gate -q`
